# Addition Building & Design

> A full-service residential design-build firm specializing in custom homes, luxury additions, and renovations across the Greater Los Angeles area.

Addition Building & Design is a Los Angeles-based general contractor offering integrated design and construction services for residential projects. The firm specializes in hillside construction, fire-resistant homes, and luxury room additions across premium neighborhoods including Pacific Palisades, Hollywood Hills, Malibu, and Bel Air.
